paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, showing six distinct categories. The chart is divided into six slices, each labeled with an emotion and a corresponding percentage: Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (dark blue, 23.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Sadness (orange, 14.7%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), and Happiness (pink, 8.1%). A legend is not explicitly provided, but the colors and labels are clearly visible. The percentages are displayed inside each slice, and the slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size. No slices are visually emphasized beyond their color and label.
